dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent elliptical 'O' and semi-circular 'C' structures exhibit irregular, jagged outer perimeters with sharp light-to-dark intensity gradients; a central closed ring features a slightly thicker dorsal edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, dark, solid-tone pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the interstitial spaces between larger annular structures and along the ventral transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three primary closed-ring structures form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal midline.
